notes: New: **Deep check** (section 10, next to Run system check). The system check only looks at files; the deep check really runs both speech models on the first 20 seconds of the open video (or a spoken test sentence) and shows, step by step, what works, what fails or is slow, whether the graphics card or only the processor does the work, and how long a 1-minute Hinglish clip will take on this computer. A step that waits instead of working is stopped after 3 minutes and named, with a report of where it was waiting. "Copy report" gives a text to send for help (it is also included in "Copy support info"). Takes 2–10 minutes and changes nothing.
